title: Saoirse
type: Player character · healer and aspiring teacher
dek: A gentle manner and practical offers of help survive exhaustion, while her companions sometimes have to insist that care includes her.

facts.Status: Resting at Vey and Vaa’s refuge at the expedition’s close

sources: Quest RP refreshed source · supplied 23 October 2026 · 3,845 messages across the main channel and two accessible threads; posting chronology and narrated continuations remain distinct
body:
Saoirse says she came to help and intends to educate Pristinia’s young. The northern expedition shows that aspiration beside travel, fatigue, combat and offers of ordinary aid.

An intention spoken in remembrance

At Papirak’s funeral she introduces herself and says she has decided to help educate Pristinia’s young. The statement establishes an intention; it does not by itself document a school opening or completed teaching program.

Scene references: 1.

Travel has a cost

She offers Lucien tea, becomes exhausted on the road and tries to rest. When the ambush wakes her she fights with conjured petals and calls for the remaining attackers to surrender. Her final tidal wave knocks the last foe prone, helping the party preserve a prisoner.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

Offering aid, and accepting it

At the refuge she asks what the Dasa need and considers food, weapons and a safer place. Felicity sees her fatigue, secures hospitality and leads her to rest. Saoirse accepts, asking to be woken for trouble or a fine flower. The Dasa’s future arrangements remain proposals, while the night’s care is real.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4.
